text:
devin: Heads-up — we need a short sync to finalize the prod-onramp acceptance checklist for the new dedicated-routing feature. I want clear gates for SLA, docs, support, monitoring, and pricing before we flip traffic.

maria: +1. Can we keep the checklist to 5 must-have items so legal/commercial can sign off quickly?

aj: For SLA, proposal: 99.9% uptime for dedicated clusters, p95 latency < 150ms for 1k token requests. Is that the bar we want to commit to?

sara: That latency target sounds OK for Dedicated, but we should call out fallback behavior if quantized variant hits higher p95 under burst. Add a rollback playbook link.

devin: Good point. Put the rollback playbook under docs and call owner @tom-oncall. Also need explicit canary thresholds: error-rate < 0.5% and token-cost delta < +20% during canary.

liam: From finops angle, we need a documented pricing floor and an internal pricing backstop for the first 30 days of GA. Also indicate which billing SKUs are affected. I can draft the short paragraph.

aj: Who's on docs? We need a one-page quickstart + runbook. Docs owners: @maria for quickstart, @sara for runbook. Target: publish draft by EOD Thu.

maria: I'll add a short checklist in the repo: 1) SLA spec 2) Runbook link 3) Canary metrics 4) Billing notes 5) Observability dashboards. Will add owners inline.

deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled: 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC (canary) -> 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC (ramp).

tom-oncall: I'll own oncall for canary. If errors spike >0.8% for 3 consecutive mins I will roll back. Also please add alert: "dedicated-routing:error-rate" to paging channel.

sara: Observability: set these dashboards before canary — p95 latency, error_rate, token_cost_delta, cache_hit_ratio. Set 1m and 5m windows. Add anomaly detection on p95.

liam: On billing, we should gate GA sign-off on two things: sample customer billing test (internal account) shows < +25% unit-cost, and commercial sign-off on SKU mapping. I will post the test results in this thread.

devin: Owner matrix we agreed on last week still applies. Quick reminder: docs=maria, runbook=sara, oncall=tom-oncall, finops=liam, release-owner=aj. Anyone disagree?

maria: all good from docs side. I'll ping legal if we need SLA wording tweaks.

aj: No objections. Action items: Maria publish draft, Sara publish runbook, Liam run billing test, Tom add alert, Devin confirm deploy window with infra. We'll reconvene Thu 11am if anything blocks.

devin: Thanks — I'll post a condensed checklist for exec review after we close those action items. :+1:
